title: The King of Fighters Orochi Collection/Walkthrough
text:
__TOC__

Overview

Characters introduced in The King of Fighters '94
Total number of Characters: 25 (of which 24 are playable + 1 unplayable boss character)
Characters appearing from other fighting games: 10
Art of Fighting (5 characters): King, Robert, Ryo, Takuma, Yuri
Fatal Fury (5 characters): Andy, Joe, Kim, Mai, Terry
Characters appearing from other non-fighting games: 5
Psycho Soldier (2 characters)
 Athena Asamiya - A Japanese high school girl with psycho powers from her ancestor Princess Athena.
 Sie Kensou - A young psycho powers fighter from China. 
Ikari Warriors (2 characters)
 Clark Still - A mercenary for the Ikari Warriors agency.
 Ralf Jones - A mercenary for the Ikari Warriors agency. Superior officer to Clark.
Ikari III - The Rescue (1 character)
 ../Heidern/ - A mercenary for the Ikari Warriors agency. Superior officer to Ralf and Clark.
New Characters: 10
 Benimaru Nikaido - Fights using the power of electricity. Wears a rather short costume and an unusual hairstyle.
 Brian Battler - A violent Football player from the USA.
 Chang Koehan - Once a feared and violent criminal in Korea, he is now supervised by Kim. Best (and only) friend of Choi.
 Chin Gentsai - The elderly mentor to Athena and Kensou.
 Choi Bounge - Once a feared and violent criminal in Korea, he is now supervised by Kim. Best (and only) friend of Chang.
 Goro Daimon - A former gold medalist of Judo and a mentor to his own dojo.
 Heavy D! - A boxing character and the leader of Team USA.
 Kyo Kusanagi - A fighting High School student and one of the main (canonial) winners of the King of Fighters tournaments.
 Lucky Glauber - A karate champion who is also a former professional basketball player.
 Rugal Bernstein - A wealthy arms dealer and host of the KoF '94 Tournament. (Appears only as a not playable boss character)

Characters introduced in The King of Fighters '95
Total number of Characters: 26 (all playable)
Characters reappearing from previous game (KoF '94): 22 
(Andy, Athena, Benimaru, Chang, Chin, Choi, Clark, Daimon, Heidern, Joe, Kensou, Kim, King, Kyo, Mai, Ralf, Robert, Rugal, Ryo, Takuma, Terry, Yuri)
Characters not reappearing from previous game (KoF '94): 3 
(Brian, Heavy D, Lucky)
Characters appearing from other fighting games: 2
Art of Fighting (1 character): Eiji
Fatal Fury (1 character): Billy
New Characters: 2
Iori Yagami - The main rival of Kyo Kusanagi. Wields pyrokinetic powers.
Saisyu Kusanagi - The head of the Kusanagi clan and the father of Kyo Kusanagi.

Characters introduced in The King of Fighters '96
Total number of Characters: 29 (of which 27 are playable in all versions + 2 are only playable in the CD version)
Characters reappearing from previous game (KoF '95): 20 
(Andy, Athena, Benimaru, Chang, Chin, Choi, Clark, Daimon, Iori, Joe, Kensou, Kim, King, Kyo, Mai, Ralf, Robert, Ryo, Terry, Yuri)
Characters not reappearing from previous game (KoF '95): 6 
(Billy, Eiji, Heidern, Rugal, Saisyu, Takuma)
Characters appearing from other fighting games: 4
Art of Fighting (2 characters): Kasumi, Mr. Big
Fatal Fury (2 characters): Geese, Krauser
New Characters: 5
Chizuru Kagura - A mysterious woman with deep connections to the Orochi powers and who sponsors the KoF '96 tournament.
Leona Heidern - The daughter of Heidern and his replacement in the Ikari Warriors Team.
Leopold Goenitz - One of the four heavenly kings of Orochi and a very powerful fighter.
../Mature/ - One of the two secretaries of Rugal Bernstein. She can wield the Orochi power.
../Vice/ - One of the two secretaries of Rugal Bernstein. She can wield the Orochi power and is thought to be a very cruel person.

Characters introduced in The King of Fighters '97
Total number of Characters: 30 (of which 29 are playable + 1 unplayable boss character)
Number of Characters with alternate versions available: 6
(Chris, Iori, Kyo, Leona, Shermie, Yashiro)
Characters reappearing from previous game (KoF '96): 22 
(Andy, Athena, Benimaru, Chang, Chin, Chizuru, Choi, Clark, Daimon, Iori, Joe, Kensou, Kim, King, Kyo, Leona, Mai, Ralf, Robert, Ryo, Terry, Yuri)
Characters not reappearing from previous game (KoF '96): 7 
(Geese, Goenitz, Kasumi, Krauser, Mature, Mr.Big, Vice)
Characters reappearing from older KoF games: 1 
KoF '95: Billy
Characters appearing from other fighting games: 2
Fatal Fury (2 characters): Blue Mary, Yamazaki
New Characters: 5
../Chris/ - One of the Four Heavenly Kings of Orochi and the dark Orochi counterpart to Kyo Kusanagi.
../Orochi/ - One of the series main villains and the final boss of KoF '97.
../Shermie/ - One of the Four Heavenly Kings of Orochi and the dark Orochi counterpart to Benimaru Nikaido.
Shingo Yabuki - A simple, plain and friendly character who considers all fighters as his friends and is liked by most other contestants.
Yashiro Nanakase - One of the Four Heavenly Kings of Orochi and the dark counterpart to Goro Daimon.

Characters introduced in The King of Fighters '98
Total number of Characters: 38 (all playable)
Number of Characters with alternate versions available: 13
(Andy, Billy, Chris, Joe, Kyo, Mai, Robert, Rugal, Ryo, Shermie, Terry, Yashiro, Yuri)
Characters reappearing from previous game (KoF '97): 29 
(Andy, Athena, Benimaru, Billy, Mary, Chang, Chin, Chizuru, Choi, Chris, Clark, Daimon, Iori, Joe, Kensou, Kim, King, Kyo, Leona, Mai, Ralf, Robert, Ryo, Shermie, Shingo, Terry, Yamazaki, Yashiro, Yuri)
Characters not reappearing from previous game (KoF '97): 1 
(Orochi)
Characters reappearing from older KoF games: 9
KoF '94: Brian, Lucky, Heavy D
KoF '95: Heidern, Rugal, Saisyu, Takuma
KoF '96: Mature, Vice
New Characters: 0
